g.text: Execution map / Repository configuration and recorded private lab
A1 Private controller → A2A message/send to iot-coordinator
Solid: request, returned data or artifact. Dashed purple: release control.
Training and serving releases are selected separately. Online views are distinct.
K1 indexing is separate from A1 retrieval. See the guide for timing and failure branches.
